4. Charges other than tuition 
Application for coverage of fees other than tuition (i.e. Admissions, Transcripts, 
Parking, and Extended Education) must be sent to the appropriate department in 
order to prevent disruptions to student services 
5. Important Dates for the Winter 2018 Term 
 
Below are the important timelines that must be adhered to. 
  
                 Description 
Winter Term (Jan-April 2018) 
Final Date for receipt of Sponsorship 
Applications without penalties 
9th January 2018  
Final Date for receipt of Sponsorship 
Applications with penalties 
10th February 2018  
Invoices Issued to Sponsors 
6th to 12th February 2018  
Invoice due date 
All fees are due upon receipt of invoice 
 
If payment has not been made by the due date, you and your sponsor will be notified 
by email that payment has not been received.  Following which your student account 
will be placed on hold and access to administrative services will be suspended and 
future term registration will not be permitted until the overdue balance has been 
paid in full. 
 
6. Penalties 
 
Sponsorship application received after the deadline of 9th January 2018, will result in 
an assessment of $50 late payment penalty to your Student account and further $40 
late fee will be applied at the end of revision period if the Sponsorship application is 
not received. 
Once the invoice is 30 days or more past due, the University reserves the right to 
deny any further credit to the sponsor, and overdue student account may be subject 
to regular collection processes. 
I hope this information is helpful, and if you require further information, 
please do not hesitate to contact me at the number below.
